full_text_en:
Liu Wensheng — Embezzlement Case

Defendant: Liu Wensheng, male, 19 years old, formerly served as a clearing clerk of Yueyang City South District Urban Credit Cooperative, arrested on July 17, 1989.

The Yueyang City People's Procuratorate brought a public prosecution against the defendant Liu Wensheng for embezzlement to the Yueyang Intermediate People's Court. The Yueyang Intermediate People's Court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law and, after open trial, found the following:

During his tenure as a clearing clerk of Yueyang City South District Urban Credit Cooperative, from June 24 to June 29, 1989, the defendant Liu Wensheng, by means of fabricating accounts and making unauthorized transfers, transferred a total of 189,764 yuan from the unit's account in three separate transactions and deposited the money under the names of "Zhang Xiaoming" and "Liu Wensheng" into three bank savings offices at Desheng Road, Dongmaoling, and Xianfeng Road in the same city, appropriating it for himself. From June 26 to July 3, 1989, Liu Wensheng withdrew cash in the amount of 107,000 yuan from the bank savings offices on nine separate occasions.

On June 29, 1989, Liu Wensheng read a document issued by the Yueyang City People's Bank concerning the implementation of new settlement procedures for banks. Fearing that his crime might be exposed, he wrote three letters respectively to his parents, his siblings, and his unit, and placed them in his desk drawer. Thereafter, on July 1, he took over 100,000 yuan in cash and checked into Yueyang Hotel, waiting for an opportunity to flee. On the afternoon of July 3, the Urban Credit Cooperative discovered the three letters written by Liu Wensheng and realized that Liu Wensheng intended to abscond with the money. The cooperative then sent someone to inform Liu Wensheng's mother and his second elder sister, Liu Aili. After Liu Aili learned that Liu Wensheng was staying at Yueyang Hotel, she rushed to the hotel at 6:00 p.m. that evening and persuaded Liu Wensheng to surrender the illicit money and turn himself in to his unit. Liu Wensheng immediately handed over 94,440 yuan in illicit money. Subsequently, accompanied by Liu Aili and others, Liu Wensheng went to the Urban Credit Cooperative and confessed all the facts of his crime of embezzling public funds and the whereabouts of the remaining illicit money. Liu Wensheng's relatives also paid the remaining 8,000 yuan in full.

The above facts are verified by conclusive and sufficient evidence, and the defendant Liu Wensheng also confessed to them.

The Yueyang Intermediate People's Court held that: The defendant Liu Wensheng, being a state functionary, took advantage of his position to embezzle over 189,700 yuan in public funds, and his conduct constituted the crime of embezzlement as provided for in Article 155, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China. According to the provisions of Article 2, Item (1) of the Supplementary Provisions of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress Concerning the Punishment of the Crimes of Embezzlement and Bribery, he should be severely punished. After committing the crime, Liu Wensheng, under the persuasion of his relatives, confessed all the facts of embezzlement to his unit and returned all the illicit money. This should be considered voluntary surrender. In accordance with Article 7 of the Notice of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Criminals of Embezzlement, Bribery, Speculation, etc. Must Surrender and Confess Within a Time Limit ("After the issuance of this Notice, with respect to ongoing economic crime cases such as embezzlement, bribery, and speculation, where the criminal has voluntarily surrendered and confessed or has reported and rendered meritorious service, the provisions of Article 2 of this Notice shall apply") and Article 63 of the Criminal Law, the punishment may be mitigated. It is appropriate to impose a punishment below the statutory punishment on Liu Wensheng in accordance with Article 59, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law. According to Article 60 of the Criminal Law, all property illegally obtained by the criminal shall be recovered. Accordingly, the Yueyang Intermediate People's Court rendered the following judgment on September 22, 1989:

The defendant Liu Wensheng was found guilty of embezzlement and sentenced to six years' imprisonment.

The property illegally obtained by Liu Wensheng shall be recovered.

After the judgment of first instance was rendered, the defendant Liu Wensheng did not appeal.
